titulo: More Than Skin Deep: Loculated Pericardial Effusion Causing Localized Cardiac Tamponade Due to Cutibacterium acnes Pericarditis

fig.label: Figure 4
fig.caption: Parasternal long-axis view of the heartThe figure demonstrates the loculated pericardial effusion inferolateral to the heart (yellow arrow) and in the oblique sinus (orange arrow). This is causing diastolic collapse of the left ventricular inferolateral wall and diastolic bowing of the interventricular septum towards the right ventricle (red arrows). Adhesions of the cardiac surface to the pericardium are seen (green arrow)
